definitions.explanation: Someone accepted into a program that trains them for a specific post, and who will take up that post once training is complete. From {候補|こうほ} (candidacy) + {生|せい} (student). Almost always used with a preceding word naming the post: {幹部候補生|かんぶこうほせい}, {宇宙飛行士候補生|うちゅうひこうしこうほせい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幹部候補生|かんぶこうほせい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My older brother was hired as a management trainee.

examples.japanese: {候補生|こうほせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年間|さんねんかん}→三年間：28861_sannenkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Cadets undergo three years of training.

examples.japanese: {宇宙飛行士候補生|うちゅうひこうしこうほせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十人|じゅうにん}→十人：28475_juunin⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だった。
examples.english: Only ten people were chosen as astronaut candidates.

examples.japanese: {候補生|こうほせい}のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一通|ひととお}り→一通り：21284_hitotoori⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧だ。
examples.english: It's this company's policy to have trainees experience every part of the workplace while they are still in training.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- {幹部候補生|かんぶこうほせい}: management trainee (a common hiring track at Japanese companies)
- {自衛官候補生|じえいかんこうほせい}: Self-Defense Force recruit
- {宇宙飛行士候補生|うちゅうひこうしこうほせい}: astronaut candidate
- {候補生|こうほせい}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: one's days as a trainee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {研修生|けんしゅうせい}: trainee — someone receiving training, with no promise of a particular post afterward
- ⟦{見習|みなら}い→見習い：18735_minarai⟧: apprentice — learning a trade by watching and assisting, often manual work
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧: newcomer, rookie — already in the job, just new to it
